title: Board Redraw Modes And Logical Graph Layout
description: Generalize board layout simulation into Redraw modes: force-graph and hierarchical-tree share tick-based redraw plumbing; each accepts logical fixture nodes without required x,y (seed positions in WASM). Unify TS API and board play settings UI (shared vs per-mode params).
summary: Hierarchical-tree redraw now uses a Buchheim (Walker-style) tidy-tree in WASM: spanning forest from directed edges with min-depth parent choice, synthetic multi-root for multi-tree graphs, scaled to layerSpacing/siblingGap and mapped by direction (down/up/right/left). TS/Rust docstrings note the algorithm. wasm-pack rebuilt; Vitest 55 tests and cargo test 26 tests passed.
